beats.section_title: BUILDING AND SHUFFLING THE DECK
beats.written: Two nested `For` loops. The outer loop walks through ranks 2 to 14. The inner loop walks through the four suits. We drop each card into the array at the current index and bump the index. After both loops finish, we have a perfectly ordered 52-card deck.

Sub BuildDeck(ByRef Deck() As Card)
    Dim Suits() As Char = {"S"c, "H"c, "D"c, "C"c}
    Dim Rank As Integer
    Dim SuitIndex As Integer
    Dim Index As Integer

    Index = 0
    For Rank = 2 To 14
        For SuitIndex = 0 To 3
            Deck(Index).Rank = Rank
            Deck(Index).Suit = Suits(SuitIndex)
            Index = Index + 1
        Next SuitIndex
    Next Rank
End Sub

beats.written: This is a Fisher-Yates shuffle — the gold standard for producing an unbiased random permutation. Sub ShuffleDeck(ByRef Deck() As Card)

    Dim j As Integer

        Deck(i) = Deck(j)
        Deck(j) = Temp
    Next i
End Sub

Function DrawTopCard(ByRef H As Hand) As Card
